---
name: Feature proposal
about: Propose an evidence-based prospecting workflow or capability.
title: "[Proposal] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## User and decision

Who needs this, and what decision or action will it help them take?

## Proposed workflow

Describe the inputs, research steps, output, and human review points.

## Evidence and dependencies

Which sources or services are required? Explain access requirements and any expected API costs without including keys or account data.

## Acceptance criteria

How could a contributor verify that this works? Describe a synthetic or publishable example and important limitations.

## Alternatives

What can users do today, and why is this addition useful?
